text: Independent pass 24 verified the sparse identity fix end to end at p=50k: plan_geometry 3.8s, evaluate_geometry 59.3s, full geometry 93.0s, about 166s total. The earlier p^1.8 / 19-minute extrapolation was an artifact of sparse-to-dense hashing and is superseded. Real scale gate instrumentation still needs isolated peak-RSS and learned dense-metric measurements.
